summary.text: Trojan whom Achilles smote upon the back with a thrust of his spear as he leapt down from his car and fled before him, bellowing like a bull dragged to the altar — Apollodorus counts Hippodamas among Priam's sons by other women, distinct from the Calydonian eponym father of Euryte.

story.text: Hippodamas thereafter, as he leapt down from his car and fled before him, Achilles smote upon the back with a thrust of his spear. And as he breathed forth his spirit he gave a bellowing cry, even as a bull that is dragged belloweth, when young men drag him about the altar of the lord of Helice; for in such doth the Shaker of Earth delight; even so bellowed Hippodamas, as his lordly spirit left his bones.
